name: x30
about: The 30 s cut of the launch film for X, reveal first (the lead's pick, 2026-10-24). ranges: LaunchFilm source frames [first, end), in playing order (30 fps, 18 frames a beat, 72 a bar). Every range starts on the same beat of the bar in the film and in the cut, so the film's clicks, cuts and lines stay on their beats and the score's own bars play under them (music.score_bars). Read by tools/captions/build.mjs --cut (captions), tools/encode/encode.sh --cut (picture), tools/audio/cut_cues.py (the cut's sound effects) and tools/audio/cut_soundtrack.sh (its music and mix).

music.cadence: 7 A7sus4 -> 8 D (the reveal, cut frame 216); 30 Gmaj9 -> 31 D(add9) (plagal; the final chord at cut frame 720), ringing through 32

add.event: the joint onto the held run: the lock, as the music muffles
add.why: the film's ui_lock sits on f890, before the range [900, 1224); the cut's hold starts on this joint (ENERGY_SPEC §10)
